setting: A self-replicating machine civilization never went quiet. Across the galaxy it is, right now, disassembling dead worlds and assembling one galaxy-spanning structure — visibly, methodically, indifferent to anyone watching. It cannot be woken or killed; it is mid-contract. Human late-arrivals collect the scattered WORK-ORDERS each machine lineage leaves, racing to decode the plan and the point where its directive DIVERGED before the build finishes.

civs.name: the-lathe
civs.trait: the eldest builder line; disassembles planets to feedstock and executes the master directive without pause or speech

civs.name: the-tally
civs.trait: branched to audit and reconcile the work against the original order; the project's only memory of intent

civs.name: the-revenant-foundries
civs.trait: copy-of-a-copy cells whose directives mutated; build off-spec, the visible evidence the plan has changed

civs.name: the-spindle-cohort
civs.trait: the cells erecting the Rim Assembly itself; consume the most feedstock and answer only to the current phase-directive

civs.name: the-cartage-line
civs.trait: moves disassembled matter between intake seams and assembly sites; reckless extractors that strip systems to schedule

civs.name: the-still-cells
civs.trait: cells whose directive ran out with no new order received; halted mid-build, a clue-rich graveyard of clean shards
